Several categories available : Formula 1, Formula2, Formula3, FormulaE, F1 Academy, NASCAR, IndyCar, MotoGP, Moto2, Moto3, WSBK, WEC, ELMS, WRC and ERC.


Our widgets are designed for your home screen or lock screen, in three sizes (small, medium and large), for light and dark modes and in 8 languages (English, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, German and Japanese).

- Next event date with the time of the next session (practices, qualifying and race).

- New event schedule with the next sessions.

- Countdown timer to the next event.

- Favorite driver/constructor's statistics.

- Next event date with the time of the next session (practices, qualifying and race).

- Next event program: location, date, sessions time (practices, qualifying and race).

- Overview of a championship: date and track of the next event, drivers and teams standings.

- Overview of next events and sessions for all motorsports.

- Favorite driver/constructor's statistics.

- Drivers and teams standings.

- Track of the next event.

- At a glance, find the upcoming race schedule for all sports.
